### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Redirect /agents to /agent-platform/agents](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2887) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Links to `/agents` and the paths below it, such as `/agents/new`, open the same page under `/agent-platform/agents` instead of a not-found page. Where the Agent Platform section is disabled, `/agents` stays not found.
